[[Image:Caps z dm2.jpg]]
Map pick by Clan Z.

Demos: [https://www.quakeworld.nu/w/images/2/27/Caps_z_brutal_dm2.qwz brutal (CAPS)]

"This game was played on a Inet server, giving Z somewhat of a ping-advantage. Enough to compensate for CAPSlock's players being in the same room? Anyhow, as these games go, it started out quite chaotic, but it was CAPSlock who came out on top effecting a lockdown of the map with two minutes played. After only three minutes they were leading by 30 frags and were looking very strong. Z regrouped and put pressure on them, nagging at the high rl and quad and loading up in the RA/100H-room. Spetnaz from Z managed to claim upper rl but CAPS showed of their great tp in keeping their positions clear. Finally, it was Mindless of Z that managed to snag a Quad and do some serious damage before being stopped. Next quad again went to CAPS who, 9 minutes into the game, were up by 68 frags. Z's players were mostly hold up in the RA/100H area. And then Spetnaz gets quad, which signals a major comeback from Z who race to settle the scores. CAPS fought back, but after a while, Z took control of the map and it was CAPSlock who hid in the backroom whilst Z's players were fragging like ... players from clan Z actually. In the end, they didn't have enough time ... but they did make the scores look much better!" -Ego === DM3 === CAPS: 116 - Z: 101
[[Image:Caps z dm3.jpg]]
Map pick by CAPSLOCK.

Demos: [https://www.quakeworld.nu/w/images/d/dd/Caps_z_dm3_dark.qwz DARKLORD (CAPS)]

"This map was played on a swedish server with both teams having very even pings. The game began with Z taking the Quad and CAPS getting the pent. Still, Z made the most of their share, perhaps spirited on by the fragrally in the last minutes of DM2. They fought hard and were in the lead by 5 frags in the third minute of the game. They increased this by holding the RA and bagging a few CAPSlockers. Still, CAPS seemed to have the positions but Z was leading with 25 points in the 6:th minute. After that they had a few quads that helped loose up the scores, but CAPS was soon back into it, taking Quad and YA in the 11:th minute and turning a 20-25 frag lead by Z into a shaky 10 frag head start. With Eight minutes left, CAPS tie the game against Z ... exciting! Z takes a quad around the 15:th minute whilst CAPS gets a pent.Z then tried to attack the RA which was held by CAPSlock. They sent in their quadguy who got killed and then CAPS launched an assault on all Z's positions. There was a large brawl over one of the quads, resulting in a huge loss of players from both sides. CAPSlock took the packs and evened up the scores a bit. Z had a bare three frags lead in the 13:th minute. They again tie the game but proceed to take more frags, giving them a slim 4 frag lead with one minute to go! They then proceeded to clear the map of Z-players for the last seconds of the game ... GG to both teams, great TP!" -Ego == Summary == * Score: 2-0 * Total frags ** CAPS: 289 ** Z: 250 __NOTOC__ [[Category:Matchreports]]
